Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6 in the title block.
The 
first draft is initiated by eng. Emad Mohamed El-Tohamy, tested by eng. Sawsan 
Elsaid Ali, reviewed by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Aly Moussa, 
accepted by eng. Mohamed Abd El-Sadik Ahmed: general manager, approved by eng Aly Anor El-Faumy, 
and certified by eng. Mona Ahmed Al Sherqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer "A" and 
MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy 
 equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, etc.

 it.
